sub_agent_reviews.summary: Single merged Scout covered llm-agent, llm-post-training, and ai-safety. Candidate table included Do AI Agents Know When a Task Is Simple? (duplicate live), PalmClaw, Tracing Agentic Failure from the Flow of Success (selected), EG-VAR, Resist and Update, and Bulkhead.
Read the arXiv abstract, HTML full text, method sections, experiment tables, appendix limitations, and code repository README/scripts before writing the Chinese Markdown analysis.
Mapped OAT's step representation, Neural CDE, gated control path, Top-k and conformal prediction detection, datasets, metrics, ablations, and code pipeline.
Called out that anomaly scores are not causal proof, MCP-Atlas labels are manually judged, CP thresholds can miss boundary errors, and OOD evaluation is failure-only.
Searched third-party and author pages; only current lightweight index pages were found, so the article relies mainly on arXiv full text plus the anonymous code/data repository.
Markdown uses TL;DR, h3 sections, tables, formulas, a Mermaid pipeline, and no external image URLs.
